overview: Crystal Sun Outcroppings are the most magically volatile zone in Scarlet Desert.
details: Sunlight refracts through massive crystal spires, creating solar resonance fields that spawn crystal elementals and destabilize the terrain.
hooks: A crystal spire begins emitting dangerous solar pulses.
Crystal elementals gather near a prism cavern.
A solar resonance field expands toward Twilight Ridge.
A Seru expedition disappears near the crystal terraces.
